create_ParamHolder: create a ParamHolder nn.Module with a param shape and key list for indexed parameter storage
use_ParamHolder_to_idx: use ParamHolder to_idx method to convert key names or tuples into tensor indices for lookup
use_ParamHolder_from_idx: use ParamHolder from_idx method to convert tensor indices back into their corresponding key names
use_ParamHolder_forward: use ParamHolder forward method to retrieve parameter values by passing a tensor of indices
use_to_device: use to_device to recursively move nested tensors, ndarrays, and modules to a target device with optional caching
